final_command_checks.scope: Final recorded brake/steering commands, software floors and existing limits; not measured tire forces.

definitions.motion: Measured ego XY/yaw finite differences at actual50Hz; no reference heading derivative is used for body metrics. These are simulator motion derivatives, not tire-force sensors. The measured_yaw metrics use central np.gradient twice; explicitly named forward_difference metrics use consecutive angular rates and match the historical1.0185363506rad/s2 baseline definition. Compare like estimators only.
definitions.band_power: Offline Welch integrated1–6Hz power and third-order1Hz high-pass; diagnostic of rapid motion, not proof all such motion is unwanted. Never an online controller/video filter.
definitions.steering: Reuses the frozen previous steering metric definitions for directly comparable TV/rate/acceleration/reversal counts.
definitions.anchors: Same18 predeclared original-map curvature anchors; same-progress plannedXY error and±10m road-use window. These locations are not asserted to be true physical apexes or optimum lap locations.
definitions.wheel_clearance: Four actual-heading wheel centers with frozen3.2m wheelbase/.85m halftrack; distance to local generated inner white-line edge. Positive if that wheel is inside the full local road strip, negative outside. Negative may therefore be outside either edge; raw membership and inner-side labels are retained.
definitions.closest_wheel: Closest absolute inner-wheel-to-inner-edge distance among legal>=2wheel samples in the fixed±10m window. Not a new track-limit definition or guarantee of a true apex hit.
definitions.capture: Controller-reported geometry and independent measuredXY distance to same-progress frozen nominal map path are distinct metrics.
definitions.truth: All actual poses and native director audits are offline scoring only; no opponent truth is supplied to the driver.
